sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: ==QA Automation Engineer== with 6+ years of experience ==designing, developing, and maintaining automated test frameworks and test scripts== for web applications, and ==hands-on mobile app testing on Android and iOS==. ==Automated 270+ regression test cases== using BrowserStack LCNC and ACCELQ, developed Selenium WebDriver automation, and ==integrated test suites into CI/CD pipelines== (Azure DevOps). ==Performs functional, regression and API testing==, ==analyses test results, reports defects and helps troubleshoot issues==, and creates and maintains test documentation. ==Currently upskilling in Python for test automation== through structured training, with a strong automation foundation to apply across mobile and web platforms.

sections.note: FILL-IN — the JD's gate is Python + Appium mobile automation. The resume shows mobile testing on Android/iOS but automation via Java/Selenium and low-code tools, with Python only 'learning'. [Python]/[Appium] are placeholders — fill only if genuinely true. If not, this role is a stretch: the honest angle is mobile functional testing + strong automation framework experience + active Python upskilling, best framed in a cover note.
